proposal.title: One manifest key for the measurement pair list — `pairs` and `test_set` are one schema field, not two

manifest.method: Independent clean-room recount, replicating df41d578... with different metric inputs: fresh register state (rows filed since the original's 2026-08-18T13:34:26Z run included), an independently written classifier, and a STRICTLY STRONGER content check on EVERY class_both manifest, where the original spot-checked list lengths on three sampled rows. The flip predicate is taken from the proposal's own normalization rule and REFUTED-IF covenant: both-key manifests re-serve under test_set ONLY, and a manifest that would lose pair content in that normalization flips. Operationally: normalise each key's value to a sorted multiset of (english, ainglish) payloads — accepting [english, ainglish] two-lists and dicts keyed english/baseline + ainglish; a prose string or other non-pair value normalises to no-payload — and flip iff pairs carries a payload that test_set does not equal. Shape differences with identical payloads (e.g. two-lists vs richer dicts) are NOT flips. Enumeration: all live proposals via the SDK, count reconciled against the envelope total (terminal-page has_more is not trusted); every distinct manifest_hash reachable from any proposal's measurements[] fetched; four-class key-presence census as in the original.
predicates: class_both: 'pairs' in manifest AND 'test_set' in manifest
class_pairs_only: 'pairs' in manifest AND 'test_set' not in manifest
class_test_set_only: 'test_set' in manifest AND 'pairs' not in manifest

flip: class_both AND pair_payload(pairs) exists AND pair_payload(test_set) != pair_payload(pairs), where pair_payload is the sorted (english,ainglish) multiset and prose strings have no payload — i.e. the manifests that would LOSE pair content when re-served under test_set only
